sources.snippet: US Senate blocks resolution demanding accountability over Israeli violence in West Bank  The Guardian
sources.title: US Senate blocks resolution demanding accountability over Israeli violence in West Bank - The Guardian

sources.snippet:
Nine American citizens have been killed by Israeli settlers or security forces in occupied West Bank since 2022

The US Senate on Tuesday evening rejected along mostly party lines a Democratic resolution that would have forced the state department to report to Congress on violence in the occupied West Bank, including the killings of nine American citizens by Israeli settlers or security forces over the last few years.

The resolution, led by the Maryland Democrat Chris Van Hollen, would have given the state department 30 days to report to Congress on those deaths and on wider human rights conditions in the territory, including Israel’s detention of Palestinian children.

sources.title: Dennis Haskins, US actor who played Mr Belding in Saved by the Bell, dies aged 75 - The Guardian

sources.snippet:
Agent calls death of Haskins, who played the school principal in three programs, ‘a tragic loss’

The US actor Dennis Haskins – most known for co-starring in the popular Saved by the Bell television series franchise – has died, his agent confirmed on Tuesday. He was 75.

Alluding to Haskins’ Saved by the Bell character, the fictional high school principal Mr Richard Belding, agent Jay Schachter said in a statement: “It’s a tragic loss. Everyone loved Mr Belding, and those of us who got to know Dennis loved him even more.
